associations.rationale: It gives a bound for an already finite pairwise-nonisomorphic family, one component of the full finiteness-and-exhaustiveness claim.

The type directly produces a finite bounded pairwise-nonisomorphic family of simple quotient modules and states that every simple A-module is equivalent to a member, exactly giving an exhaustive family.
The type constructs representatives for coatom quotient modules and exhausts other coatom quotients, but does not directly quantify over every simple representation as the displayed claim does.
